cli template.name: 00-import
FortiGate-VM64-KVM-PreRun
cli template.script:
{%- import '00-import' as main with context -%}
{%- for x in main.underlays %}
{%- if x.port is defined -%}
config system interface
    edit {{x.port}}
      set vdom "root"
      set type physical
      {% if x.ip is defined -%}
      set mode static
      set ip {{x.ip}}
      {%- elif x.ip is not defined -%}
      set mode dhcp
      {%- endif %}
    next
end
{%- endif %}
{% endfor %}
config system interface
    edit {{emgmt_port}}
        set vdom root
        set mode static
        set ip {{emgmt_subnet}}
        set vrf 250
    next
end
config router static
edit 4
set device port1
set gateway 192.168.0.254
end
config system global
    set admintimeout 30
    set hostname {{hostname}}
end
config system password-policy
set status disable
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set password {{admin_pwd}}
    next
end
config firewall policy
    purge
end

cli template.name: 10-Branch-Initial
20-Build-Nets
60-Branch-Post
50-Branch-BGP
cli template.script:
{%- import '00-import' as main with context -%}
{%- set ns = namespace(vrfs=[]) -%}
config router route-map
  edit "LAN_TAG"
    config rule
      edit 1
        set set-tag 100
      next
    end
  next
  edit "LAN_OUT"
    config rule
      edit 1
        set match-tag 100
      next
    end  
  next
  edit "LAN_OUT_DENY"
    config rule
      edit 1
        set action deny
        set match-tag 100
      next
    end  
  next
end
config router bgp
set as {{main.vars.internal_asn}}
set router-id {{main.vars.ipv4lbrange|ipmath(branch_id|int)}}
set keepalive-timer 15
set holdtime-timer 45
set ibgp-multipath enable
set graceful-restart enable
set recursive-next-hop enable
config neighbor
{% for hub in main.hubs -%}
    edit {{ hub.exchangeip }}
        set advertisement-interval 1
        set capability-graceful-restart enable
        set soft-reconfiguration enable
        set interface "Branch-Lo"
        set remote-as {{main.vars.internal_asn}}
        set connect-timer 1
        set update-source "Branch-Lo"
        {% if main.vars.vrf -%}
        set route-map-out LAN_OUT_DENY
        set soft-reconfiguration-vpnv4 enable
        set capability-graceful-restart-vpnv4 enable
        {% endif -%}
    next
{% endfor -%}
end
{% if main.vars.advpn -%}
config neighbor-group
    edit "DYN_EDGE"
        set advertisement-interval 1
        set capability-graceful-restart enable
        set next-hop-self enable
        set passive disable
        set soft-reconfiguration enable
        set interface "Branch-Lo"
        set remote-as {{main.vars.internal_asn}}
        set update-source "Branch-Lo"
        {% if main.vars.vrf -%}
        set soft-reconfiguration-vpnv4 enable
        set route-map-out LAN_OUT_DENY
        set route-map-out-vpnv4 LAN_OUT
        set capability-graceful-restart-vpnv4 enable
        {% endif -%}
    next
end
config neighbor-range
    edit 1
        set prefix {{main.vars.ipv4lbrange}}
        set neighbor-group "DYN_EDGE"
    next
end
{% endif -%}
config network
    edit 1
        set prefix {{blan1_subnet|ipaddr('network/prefix')}}
        set route-map "LAN_TAG"
    next
end
{% if main.vars.vrf -%}
config vrf
    edit "0"
        set role pe
    next
    {% for x in main.nets -%}
    {% if x.vrf is defined
          and x.bgp|default('n')|lower == 'y'
          and x.vrf not in ns.vrfs -%}
    {%- set ns.vrfs = ns.vrfs + [x.vrf] -%}
    edit {{ x.vrf }}
        set role ce
        set rd {{ main.vars.ipv4lbrange|ipmath(branch_id|int) }}:{{ x.vrf }}
        set export-rt {{ main.vars.internal_asn }}:{{ x.vrf }}
        set import-rt {{ main.vars.internal_asn }}:{{ x.vrf }}
    next
    {% endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
end
{% endif -%}
config redistribute "connected"
end
config redistribute "isis"
end
config redistribute "ospf"
end
config redistribute "rip"
end
config redistribute "static"
end
config redistribute6 "connected"
end
config redistribute6 "isis"
end
config redistribute6 "ospf"
end
config redistribute6 "rip"
end
config redistribute6 "static"
end
end
